name: Kindredly - A safer, private web for families
description: Private family-friendly browsing with tools to collect what matters, reduce distractions, and build healthier online habits.
//host_permissions: '<all_urls>' is required, not a wider restatement of the two patterns beside it. Chrome's tabs.captureVisibleTab checks for that literal pattern (or activeTab, which needs a click on the extension and so cannot serve a background capture loop); with only 'https://*/*' and 'http://*/*' it refuses with "Either the '<all_urls>' or 'activeTab' permission is required" and Live View can never take a picture. It was declared under optional_host_permissions, which nothing ever requested, so it could not be obtained at runtime either. Firefox, Safari and Gecko Android already declare it; Chrome was the odd one out. This is not a privilege increase on update -- 'https://*/*' already implies all hosts, so Chrome's warning is unchanged and no existing install goes into the needs-approval state.
